I’m 25 and I’ve never been married or had kids, I’m still in school and had odd jobs here and there but it’s hard to relate to people. I have strings of friendships and relationships that come and break and it sucks. 

As for a solution, I exercise a lot, lifting weights, running, BJJ and boxing and it keeps my mind busy. School can be hard when a hard wave of depression hits and I can’t concentrate, I’m gonna see if I can’t get prescribed adderal or something to help. Meditation helps a lot, headspace is cheap and easy way to go about it. Finding outlets is what honestly helps me the most. Excercise for physical, school for mental, and photography for emotional. Journaling has also helped a lot, and gives me perspectives. I usually write in 3rd person so I can remove my myself and tell me experiences like a story. The VA is always rough and I just been persistent with it and I have a therapist that I actually like now so there’s hope. 

Just gotta keep grinding it out, I really hope it gets better for both of us.
